food_database: USDA-NCC Carotenoid Database for U.S. Foods
geographical_origin: U.S. foods database; food-specific sampling details in source references
synonym_verification_status: Exact analyte column in database; β-cryptoxanthin measured separately
synonym_source: Holden et al. 1999, Table 3; chromatographic carotenoid data screened and compiled
moisture_basis: Edible-portion basis; database reports per 100 g food
analytical_method: Source database includes only chromatographic carotenoid separation studies; individual source method details vary
extraction_method: Compiled database; see cited source papers
sample_size: 3 source values; confidence code B; weighted mean
source_title: Carotenoid content of U.S. foods: An update of the database
database_reference: Table 3, beta-cryptoxanthin; weighted mean 39 µg/100 g edible portion, 3 sources, confidence B
extraction_notes: Table 3 value 39 µg/100 g converted to 0.39 mg/kg fresh weight (multiply by 0.01). The database reports β-cryptoxanthin as a distinct analyte; no combined-carotenoid value is used.
uncertainty_notes: Weighted mean compiled from accepted chromatographic sources; confidence B. For papaya the estimate relies on one source (n=3) and has confidence C. Underlying source-level variability and sample details differ by food.
